review.reason: Preserve the complete original3.9RoW/DE mixed-plastic and3.12RoW untreated-wood market treatment shares and every original collection-freight exchange without renormalization. Negative source waste references require factor-1 to positive treatment helpers. The unsanitary native diesel-MJ and skid-steer-m3 services reuse exact earlier operating inventory witnesses; retain their technology, fleet/filter, allocation, geography and vintage limitations, without extra fuel or infrastructure. Controlled fractions use complete native ordinary mixed-plastic incineration/sanitary-landfill or untreated-wood incineration, with all44 declared composition/heating-value coordinates matched to native2026; unknown entries stay unknown. Native2025 comments are shorter but full inventories and positive references are inspected. Native controlled-process emissions, biosphere coverage, water/oxygen, residue, background energy, allocation, technology, geography and vintage differ; score effects are unquantified and no LCIA equality is claimed. Do not rescale by product-name moisture labels: actual composition matches; no dry-mass/heating-value, capacity, lifetime or allocation multiplier is introduced. Preserve original road and country-specific rail tkm separately through complete native RER same-mode freight services. Original source country freight quantities and uncertainty remain intact, while vehicle/traction/fuel/load/age/duty/background shares are not reconstructed. No extra vehicle, road or track is added.
